items.title: New Zealand agricultural land use mapped with LUC, LUCAS and AgriBase data, 2022
items.credit: Clémence Vannier, Thomas A. Cochrane, Peyman Zawar-Reza and Larry Bellamy (2022), Land 11(12), 2334, Figure 1, CC BY 4.0
items.altText: Map of agricultural land use across New Zealand based in part on national land-use and land-use-capability data.
items.caption: A 2022 Canterbury-led map of New Zealand agricultural land use using LUCAS, Land Use Capability and AgriBase sources. It shows later spatial reuse of national land-assessment data, not an original 1970s NZLRI worksheet.
items.context: Figure 1 from Vannier and colleagues (2022). This is an actual geospatial output from New Zealand LUC and other agricultural data, created in 2022. It is not presented as a first-edition NZLRI worksheet, Land Use Capability sheet, or original LADEDA map. The primary figure caption explicitly identifies its datasets.

items.title: Automated coastal landcover classification workflow, New Zealand, 2022
items.sourceName: Remote Sensing (MDPI), volume 14, issue 19, article 4827, figure 4
items.credit: Benedict Collings, Murray Ford and Mark Dickson (2022), Remote Sensing 14(19), 4827, Figure 4, CC BY 4.0
items.altText: Multi-stage automated processing flow from New Zealand satellite image composites through rule-based masking and machine-learning classification.
items.caption: A documented 2022 University of Auckland coastal remote-sensing workflow combines satellite composites, rule-based processing and supervised classification into repeatable New Zealand mapping.
items.context: Figure 4 from Collings, Ford and Dickson (2022), using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery. Unlike a generic model-builder illustration, this documents a real New Zealand automated geospatial research workflow. It is not claimed to be an earlier NIWA or local-council processing workflow.

items.title: Machine-learning national wetland prediction, New Zealand, 2025
items.sourceName: Remote Sensing (MDPI), volume 17, issue 15, article 2626, figure 8
items.credit: Md. Saiful Islam Khan, Maria C. Vega-Corredor and Matthew D. Wilson (2025), Remote Sensing 17(15), 2626, Figure 8, CC BY 4.0
items.altText: National modelled wetland distribution compared with an existing New Zealand land-cover dataset and potential wetland extent.
items.caption: University of Canterbury researchers' 2025 national wetland prediction, comparing machine-learning output with mapped wetland datasets. This is actual New Zealand ML geospatial work, not an output from the LUCAS programme.
items.context: Figure 8 from Khan, Vega-Corredor and Wilson (2025), showing (a) national predictions of wetlands by a histogram gradient boosting model, (b) the LCDBv5 wetland layer and (c) potential wetland area. The study was published 29 July 2025. It must not be described as a LUCAS 2020 result.
